package httptransport

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/subtle"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"strings"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-tz-planner/internal/domain"
)

const maximumRequestBytes int64 = 1 << 20

type Handler struct {
	Planner       PlanningService
	InternalToken string
	Health        HealthChecker
}

type PlanningService interface {
	Plan(context.Context, string, domain.PlanningRequestV1) (domain.PlanningJob, bool, error)
	Get(context.Context, string) (domain.PlanningJob, error)
	Process(context.Context, string) (domain.PlanningJob, error)
	Stage(context.Context, string) (domain.PlanningJob, error)
	GetTechnicalTask(context.Context, string) (domain.TechnicalTaskV1, error)
	GetStudentTechnicalTask(context.Context, string) (domain.StudentTechnicalTaskViewV1, error)
}

type HealthChecker interface {
	Ping(context.Context) error
}

func (handler Handler) Router() http.Handler {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	mux.HandleFunc("GET /internal/health", handler.auth(handler.health))
	mux.HandleFunc("POST /internal/v1/authoring-jobs", handler.auth(handler.create))
	mux.HandleFunc("POST /internal/v1/source-authoring-jobs", handler.auth(handler.sourceCreate))
	mux.HandleFunc("GET /internal/v1/authoring-jobs/{id}", handler.auth(handler.get))
	mux.HandleFunc("GET /internal/v1/authoring-jobs/{id}/technical-task", handler.auth(handler.technicalTask))
	mux.HandleFunc("GET /internal/v1/authoring-jobs/{id}/student-view", handler.auth(handler.studentTechnicalTask))
	mux.HandleFunc("POST /internal/v1/authoring-jobs/{id}/resume", handler.auth(handler.resume))
	mux.HandleFunc("POST /internal/v1/authoring-jobs/{id}/stage", handler.auth(handler.stage))
	return http.MaxBytesHandler(mux, maximumRequestBytes)
}

func (handler Handler) auth(next http.HandlerFunc) http.HandlerFunc {
	return func(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
		provided := request.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token")
		if handler.InternalToken == "" || subtle.ConstantTimeCompare([]byte(provided), []byte(handler.InternalToken)) != 1 {
			writeJSON(writer, http.StatusForbidden, map[string]string{"error": "forbidden"})
			return
		}
		next(writer, request)
	}
}

func (handler Handler) health(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	if handler.Health == nil || handler.Health.Ping(request.Context()) != nil {
		writeJSON(writer, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, map[string]string{"status": "not_ready"})
		return
	}
	writeJSON(writer, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{"status": "ok"})
}

func (handler Handler) create(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	var input domain.PlanningRequestV1
	if err := decodeStrict(request.Body, &input); err != nil {
		writeJSON(writer, http.StatusBadRequest, map[string]string{"error": "invalid request"})
		return
	}
	job, created, err := handler.Planner.Plan(request.Context(), request.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key"), input)
	if err != nil {
		handler.writeError(writer, job, err)
		return
	}
	status := http.StatusOK
	if created {
		status = http.StatusCreated
	}
	writeJSON(writer, status, projectJob(job))
}

func (handler Handler) sourceCreate(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	var input domain.SourceAuthoringRequestV1
	if err := decodeStrict(request.Body, &input); err != nil || input.Schema != domain.SourceAuthoringRequestSchemaV1 {
		writeJSON(writer, http.StatusBadRequest, map[string]string{"error": "invalid source authoring request"})
		return
	}
	task := input.PreparedSourceTask
	company, _ := task.Metadata["company"].(string)
	license, _ := task.Metadata["license"].(string)
	requestModel := domain.PlanningRequestV1{
		Schema: domain.PlanningRequestSchemaV3, Mode: "private", Locale: "en",
		Source:             domain.PlanningSource{Type: "github_repository", URL: task.Source.RepositoryURL, Company: company, License: license},
		Hints:              domain.ClassificationHint{Stacks: sourceStackHints(task.Metadata)},
		PreparedSourceTask: &task,
	}
	job, created, err := handler.Planner.Plan(request.Context(), request.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key"), requestModel)
	if err != nil {
		handler.writeError(writer, job, err)
		return
	}
	status := http.StatusOK
	if created {
		status = http.StatusCreated
	}
	writeJSON(writer, status, projectJob(job))
}

func sourceStackHints(metadata map[string]any) []string {
	value, ok := metadata["stack_hints"]
	if !ok {
		return nil
	}
	switch stacks := value.(type) {
	case []string:
		return append([]string(nil), stacks...)
	case []any:
		result := make([]string, 0, len(stacks))
		for _, item := range stacks {
			if stack, ok := item.(string); ok {
				result = append(result, stack)
			}
		}
		return result
	case string:
		parts := strings.Split(stacks, ",")
		result := make([]string, 0, len(parts))
		for _, part := range parts {
			if part = strings.TrimSpace(part); part != "" {
				result = append(result, part)
			}
		}
		return result
	default:
		return nil
	}
}

func (handler Handler) get(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	job, err := handler.Planner.Get(request.Context(), request.PathValue("id"))
	if err != nil {
		handler.writeError(writer, domain.PlanningJob{}, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(writer, http.StatusOK, projectJob(job))
}

func (handler Handler) technicalTask(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	task, err := handler.Planner.GetTechnicalTask(request.Context(), request.PathValue("id"))
	if err != nil {
		handler.writeError(writer, domain.PlanningJob{}, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(writer, http.StatusOK, task)
}

func (handler Handler) studentTechnicalTask(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	task, err := handler.Planner.GetStudentTechnicalTask(request.Context(), request.PathValue("id"))
	if err != nil {
		handler.writeError(writer, domain.PlanningJob{}, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(writer, http.StatusOK, task)
}

func (handler Handler) resume(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	job, err := handler.Planner.Process(request.Context(), request.PathValue("id"))
	if err != nil {
		if current, getErr := handler.Planner.Get(request.Context(), request.PathValue("id")); getErr == nil {
			job = current
		}
		handler.writeError(writer, job, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(writer, http.StatusOK, projectJob(job))
}

func (handler Handler) stage(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	job, err := handler.Planner.Stage(request.Context(), request.PathValue("id"))
	if err != nil {
		handler.writeError(writer, job, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(writer, http.StatusOK, projectJob(job))
}

func (handler Handler) writeError(writer http.ResponseWriter, job domain.PlanningJob, err error) {
	status := http.StatusBadGateway
	switch {
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation):
		status = http.StatusUnprocessableEntity
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound):
		status = http.StatusNotFound
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict), errors.Is(err, domain.ErrLeaseHeld):
		status = http.StatusConflict
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotRunnable):
		status = http.StatusUnprocessableEntity
	}
	payload := map[string]any{"error": "authoring request failed"}
	if job.ID != "" {
		payload["job"] = projectJob(job)
	}
	writeJSON(writer, status, payload)
}

type jobProjection struct {
	ID                 string                                 `json:"id"`
	Status             domain.JobStatus                       `json:"status"`
	Attempts           int                                    `json:"attempts"`
	Orchestration      *domain.AuthoringOrchestrationIntentV1 `json:"orchestration,omitempty"`
	FailureCode        string                                 `json:"failure_code,omitempty"`
	Blueprint          *domain.TaskBlueprintV1                `json:"blueprint,omitempty"`
	CandidateDigest    string                                 `json:"candidate_digest,omitempty"`
	ContractDigest     string                                 `json:"contract_digest,omitempty"`
	CapabilitiesDigest string                                 `json:"capabilities_digest,omitempty"`
	Verification       *domain.VerificationReceiptV1          `json:"verification,omitempty"`
	Staging            *domain.StagingReceiptV1               `json:"staging,omitempty"`
}

func projectJob(job domain.PlanningJob) jobProjection {
	result := jobProjection{ID: job.ID, Status: job.Status, Attempts: job.Attempts, FailureCode: job.FailureCode}
	if job.Request.Orchestration != nil {
		orchestration := *job.Request.Orchestration
		result.Orchestration = &orchestration
	}
	if (job.Status == domain.JobStatusReady || job.Status == domain.JobStatusStaged) && job.Artifact != nil {
		blueprint := job.Artifact.Candidate.Blueprint
		verification := job.Artifact.Verification
		result.Blueprint = &blueprint
		result.CandidateDigest = job.Artifact.CandidateDigest
		result.ContractDigest = job.Artifact.ContractDigest
		result.CapabilitiesDigest = job.Artifact.CapabilitiesDigest
		result.Verification = &verification
		if job.Staging != nil {
			staging := *job.Staging
			result.Staging = &staging
		}
	}
	return result
}

func decodeStrict(reader io.Reader, output any) error {
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(reader)
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(output); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		return errors.New("trailing JSON")
	}
	return nil
}

func writeJSON(writer http.ResponseWriter, status int, payload any) {
	writer.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	writer.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	writer.WriteHeader(status)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(writer).Encode(payload)
}
